notes.title: Thank you for trying the Steam Next Fest demo!
notes.content:
The Steam Next Fest is over and that marks the end of this limited demo! Thank you for all your bug reports, suggestions and interest shown in the game! If you haven't done so yet, a wishlist helps a lot, and notifies you of the Early Access release!

Join the community on [url=https://discord.gg/kCQSehbmes]Discord[/url], engage and help shape the game!
Support on [url=https://www.patreon.com/join/tflippy]Patreon[/url] and receive a full copy early; play & test before the official release.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/690290/Territory_Control_2/

notes.title: Territory Control 2: Steam Next Fest Demo
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As some may have noticed already - there is a demo out now for a limited time for Steam Next Fest! 
The demo and dedicated servers will be up until then end of Steam Next Fest on 20 June.

We look forward to you playing the game and any feedback is welcomed
on the Steam Forums or our [url=https://discord.gg/kCQSehbmes]Discord[/url].

Territory Control 2 is best played with friends, so bring them along and create or join a faction!

After the demo, development will be mostly focused on implementing the changes based on feedback, 
as well as a multi-region Conquest gamemode, faction management, diplomacy, trading, 
end-game technologies utilizing magic, and various quality-of-like improvements such as the much-needed tutorial, modding guides and more. 

Thanks for playing!
